figurative_meaning_en: The best or most excellent person
example_sentences_in_bangla: সমাজের খলিফা হিসেবে তাকে সকলে সম্মান করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is regarded as the caliph of society, respected by all.
He is the caliph in this team, the best performer.
history: The term 'খলিফা' derives from Arabic 'khalīfah', meaning 'successor' or 'vicegerent', historically referring to the leaders of the Islamic Caliphate who succeeded the Prophet Muhammad.
note: Often used in Bengali Muslim contexts to denote excellence, akin to 'caliph of men' implying the supreme individual.
